# Fanatics: This is how you find them

![Fanatics: This is how you find them](/uploads/300_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The **Fanatics** are a **faction** in Fallout 76 that found their way into the game with the “The PITT” update on September 13th, 2022. However, you won't find them in Appalachia.

The Fanatics are a group of raiders who are in constant conflict with the Union. They are comparable to the blood eagles, but better organized. They crush all resistance and enslave the rest in forced labor.

## Places with fanatics

You will only find fanatics in **The PITT Expeditions**. To start the expeditions, all you need to do is open the map and then look for the Vertibird in the top center. Here you click on X (Xbox), R (PC) or square (Playstation) to access the expeditions.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-map-expeditions-vertibird.jpg)

Now you choose The P.I.T.T. out of. **You can only find the fanatics in The PITT!**

- **Expedition: Union Dues**
Here you will find the fanatics everywhere during the expedition except for the finale. In the final you will compete against Troggs, not against fanatics.
- **Expedition: Fire from the Ashes**
Here you can find the fanatics everywhere, indoors and outdoors. There are also Troggs in many areas there. More than in “union dues.”

## Tip for the challenge

If you just need the fanatics for the challenge, go on the expedition alone. Find the fanatics and if you don't find enough, simply cancel the expedition and start a new expedition. Since you no longer need an Ultrazit charge, you can start new expeditions as often as you like.

More information about the fanatics can be found in the Wiki.
